title: Private Tour Oahu Circle Island - Fully Personalized Experience
includes: Pick-up and Drop off to your preferred location.
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our fun and adventurous private tours can include groups of two to 24 people to explore our island and create memories to last a lifetime.

One of the benefits of a custom private tour is that you don’t have to feel rushed or guilty that you might be holding up another family or group because you choose the stops and how long you want to stay. You can truly experience the “aloha” and “magic” which is what binds the locals of the island together. Our guests enjoy our favorite spots, local foods and our stories of the island.

Whether you want to kayak or stand-up paddle board, visit the Dole Plantation, enjoy an authentic island lunch, go turtle snorkeling on the North Shore, or more, Hawaii Turtle Tours can create the perfect custom itinerary for your group. Book today!
